extracted.name: Homemade Fruit Popsicles
extracted.description: These healthy Fruit Pops are made with just three ingredients. They're an easy and fun summer treat you can feel good about giving your kids.
ingredient_lines: 1 large banana* (, cut into small pieces (frozen bananas work too))
4 large fresh strawberries* (sliced or cut into small pieces)
1/2 - 1 cups apple juice* (no sugar added, or other favorite fruit juice )
instruction_lines: Assemble: Add fruit to your popsicle mold (I use this one), alternating different kinds of fruit until the molds are filled almost to the top. Gently fill the mold with apple juice, leaving at least 1/8 in headspace and place the popsicle stick inside.
Freeze for at least 6 hours or overnight.
